confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated 2026 Seville price estimates from several aggregator and guide sites, which are crowdsourced or modeled and vary by source. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain; cocktail and wine use the local beer and bar-price relationship as a fallback because glass wine prices were not reliably found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not from inspected live listings, with July peak-season uplift assumed. EUR-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.15 and is not an RBA figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Spanish tourist city; priced against Spanish regional averages and comparable Andalusian and southern European tourist cities, adjusted for Seville's peak summer demand and historic-centre premiums.
